values: Daimon summons his guardian spirit to fight alongside him.

被动地，战斗中守护灵会帮助戴蒙作战，守护灵无法被攻击，会自动攻击距离戴蒙最近的敌人，对目标造成90% ATK伤害，戴蒙被击败后守护灵也会被击败。
主动释放时，守护灵以敌方最密集区域为中心进行一次X型爪击，造成敌方最大生命值20% + 3%的真实伤害，不超过自身500% ATK，自身及最虚弱的两名其他友军分别获得实际伤害量60%的护盾，持续8秒。

Passive. Daimon's guardian spirit, Stitchy, fights alongside him in battle, automatically attacking the enemy closest to Daimon for 90% ATK damage. Stitchy cannot be targeted or attacked, and is defeated when Daimon is defeated.
Active. Daimon commands Stitchy to unleash an X-shaped slash at the area with the most enemies, dealing true damage equal to 20% + 3% of each target's max HP. This damage cannot exceed 500% ATK. Daimon and his two weakest allies then gain a shield equal to 60% of the damage dealt, lasting for 8s.
本技能造成的伤害提高至敌方最大生命值的22% + 3%。
Increases the X-shaped slash damage to 22% + 3% of each target's max HP.
本技能造成的伤害提高至敌方最大生命值的23% + 3%。
Increases the X-shaped slash damage to 23% + 3% of each target's max HP.
本技能造成的伤害提高至敌方最大生命值的24% + 3%。
Increases the X-shaped slash damage to 24% + 3% of each target's max HP.
本技能造成的伤害提高至敌方最大生命值的25% + 3%。
Increases the X-shaped slash damage to 25% + 3% of each target's max HP.
将敌人的生命转化为自身护盾。
Daimon converts enemy's HP into a shield for himself.

被动地，守护灵每8秒能够进行1次强力攻击，对目标及周围一格的敌人造成其20%最大生命值的真实伤害，不超过戴蒙400% ATK，并将实际伤害量100%转化为戴蒙的护盾，持续8秒。
主动释放时，戴蒙将目标17% + 2%的最大生命值转化为自己的护盾，不超过戴蒙250% ATK，持续8秒。

Passive. Every 8s, Stitchy unleashes a powerful attack that deals true damage to the target and adjacent enemies, equal to 20% of the target's max HP. The true damage cannot exceed 400% ATK. 100% of the damage dealt is then converted into a shield for Daimon that lasts for 8s.
Active. Daimon drains 17% + 2% of an enemy's max HP and converts it into a shield for himself, lasting 8s. The shield value cannot exceed 250% ATK.
主动使用时的转化护盾比例提升至18% + 2%。
Increases the shield conversion rate when Daimon actively casts the skill to 18% + 2%.
主动使用时的转化护盾比例提升至19% + 2%。
Increases the shield conversion rate when Daimon actively casts the skill to 19% + 2%.
主动使用时的转化护盾比例提升至20% + 2%。
Increases the shield conversion rate when Daimon actively casts the skill to 20% + 2%.
获得护盾时，给予伙伴护盾。
Daimon grants a portion of the shield he receives to the ally bonded to him.
备战时，戴蒙与布阵在身后的一名队友结为伙伴，每当戴蒙获得护盾时，伙伴也将获得该护盾量24% + 3%的护盾，持续时间与原护盾相同，且伙伴受到来自戴蒙的任意护盾持续期间，额外提升15 + 1点生命汲取和25% + 2%攻击力。当伙伴被击败后，戴蒙会再次选择1名最虚弱的友军结为伙伴。

Daimon forms a bond with the ally placed behind him during battle preparation. Whenever Daimon gains a shield, the bonded ally also receives 24% + 3% of that shield for the same duration. While shielded by Daimon, the bonded ally gains an extra 15 + 1 Life Drain and 25% + 2% ATK. If the bonded ally is defeated, Daimon will immediately bond with the weakest ally.
伙伴从本技能中获得的护盾比例提升至26% + 3%。
The bonded ally receives 26% + 3% of the shield that Daimon gains.
伙伴从本技能中获得的护盾比例提升至28% + 3%。
The bonded ally receives 28% + 3% of the shield that Daimon gains.
伙伴从本技能中获得的护盾比例提升至30% + 3%。
The bonded ally receives 30% + 3% of the shield that Daimon gains.
受到伤害降低，拥有护盾时额外降低受到伤害。
Daimon reduces his damage taken, and by an extra percentage while shielded.
战斗中自身受到的伤害降低10%，当自身拥有护盾时，受到的伤害额外降低5%。
Daimon reduces damage taken by 10% during the battle. While shielded, he further reduces damage taken by an extra 5%.
战斗中自身受到的伤害降低14%，当自身拥有护盾时，受到的伤害额外降低6%。
Daimon reduces damage taken by 14% during the battle. While shielded, he further reduces damage taken by an extra 6%.
战斗中自身受到的伤害降低18%，当自身拥有护盾时，受到的伤害额外降低7%。
Daimon reduces damage taken by 18% during the battle. While shielded, he further reduces damage taken by an extra 7%.
使戴蒙周围的敌人陷入恐惧。
Stitchy's roar frightens enemies around Daimon.
每当戴蒙累计受到等同于最大生命值70%的生命或护盾损耗时，守护灵将返回戴蒙身边发出咆哮，咆哮会使周围3格范围内的敌人以及累计对戴蒙造成伤害最高的敌人陷入恐惧，持续2秒，每10秒至多触发1次。

Whenever Daimon's cumulative damage taken and shield value loss combined exceed 70% of his max HP, Stitchy returns to him and lets out a terrifying roar, frightening enemies within 3 tiles. The enemy who dealt the most damage to Daimon will also be frightened. The effect lasts for 2s and triggers once every 10s.
每当戴蒙累计受到等同于最大生命值50%的生命或护盾损耗时，即可触发该效果。
Stitchy returns whenever Daimon's cumulative damage taken and shield value loss combined exceed 50% of his max HP.
守护灵咆哮时将产生震耳欲聋的声波，每0.5秒对周围3格范围内的敌人以及累计对戴蒙造成伤害最高的敌人造成最大生命值5%的伤害，不超过戴蒙100% ATK，持续2秒，嚎叫结束后，守护灵会将实际伤害量100%转化为戴蒙的护盾，持续8秒。

Stitchy's roar unleashes deafening shockwaves, affecting enemies within 3 tiles and the enemy who dealt the most damage to Daimon. The roar deals damage equal to 5% of each enemy's max HP every 0.5s for 2s. This damage cannot exceed 100% ATK. Stitchy then converts 100% of the damage dealt into a shield for Daimon, which lasts for 8s.
造成的伤害提升至敌人最大生命值6%。
Increases the damage of Stitchy's roar to 6% of each enemy's max HP.
Converts leftover shield value into HP.
己方英雄任意护盾持续时间结束时，剩余护盾量的50%将转化为对该英雄的治疗。
When an allied hero's shield expires, converts 50% of the remaining shield value into healing for that hero.
